findings.evidence: The only heading is 'Welcome'; it does not describe the page's content (an invoice table), so heading and title navigation ('Welcome' is also the <title>) give no orientation.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.2 Page Titled and 2.4.6 Headings and Labels.

findings.evidence: The Date column is cut at the region edge at 1440 and Status/Amount/Date are off-screen at 375 with no visible scroll cue (no shadow, scrollbar or 'scroll for more'); the region is focusable with aria-label 'Invoices, scrolls horizontally' and a 3px ring (focus/01-on.png), so keyboard and screen-reader users are covered but sighted pointer users may not know columns exist.
findings.before: overflow-x: auto with no visual affordance
findings.after: Edge shadow on the scroll container, or reflow rows into stacked cards below 600px
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.10 Reflow (two-dimensional scroll is allowed for data tables, but content must be discoverable).

strengths: Table has a <caption>, header cells, and a focusable scroll region with an accessible name and a 3px #1d4ed8 focus ring; the checkbox has a programmatic label.
not_investigated: th scope attributes not recorded in the capture.
